relationships.meaning: Project Item references Issue-owned work; Project metadata cannot rewrite Issue state. Optional Repository import uses the Issue public bounded projection, stores only Project-owned Issue references, and rechecks source access before each batch.
Project DraftIssue conversion delegates Issue creation to the Issue owner in the same transaction; Project retains Item identity while never writing Issue truth directly.

Account User administration reads the Issue-owned unfinished-assignment activity projection for administrative display; it does not authorize User suspension or transfer Issue writer or lifecycle authority to Account.
Insights consumes issue-owned authorized current queries; source facts and authorization remain with the provider.

capabilities.intent: Manage Repository-scoped Issue creation, canonical OPEN/CLOSED state, assignee collection, editable content, and the separate local work workflow.

implementation.scope: Issue-owned canonical state/stateReason, title/body editing, 0..N assignees, local workflow responsibility, structured immutable events, replay/version invariants, and explicit RepositoryPermission operation policy
implementation.note: Issue keeps FPT IssueState/IssueStateReason separate from the local pending/active/review/completed workflow. Assignees are a 0..N Issue-owned relation and author self-assignment is valid. Current create uses schema-issues.json#IssueCreationPolicy COLLABORATORS_ONLY: every exact RepositoryPermission may open an unassigned Issue, while adding assignees, editing content, and close/reopen use the generic TRIAGE/TRIAGE_PLUS/WRITE/MAINTAIN/ADMIN management set. READ collaborators can still perform the required local workflow when they are the publisher/current assignee. PUBLIC/INTERNAL visibility may grant read-only Issue visibility but never synthesizes RepositoryPermission or Issue write authority. Structured immutable Issue events preserve state, assignment, workflow and content-change evidence; comment/label/milestone/relation/lock operations remain separate capability slices.

capabilities.intent: Read recent Issue lifecycle activity for currently accessible Repository scopes without transferring Repository authority.

implementation.scope: Issue-owned activity projection filtered by current Repository access
implementation.note: Activity reads Issue-owned lifecycle evidence and consumes Repository-owned current access plus Namespace-owned actor locators; Web composes it with Repository discovery without moving authority.

capabilities.intent: Manage Issue comments, Repository Label links, Repository Milestone assignment, Issue hierarchy/dependencies/related links, and independent conversation lock state without transferring Repository authority.

implementation.scope: Issue-owned comments, classification links, milestone assignment, typed Issue relations, and conversation lock/unlock with current access, expectedVersion, exact replay and immutable Issue events.
implementation.note: Repository retains Label and Milestone definition authority. Cross-Repository Issue relations recheck both endpoint repositories; relation reads hide inaccessible endpoints. Comments retain stable identity on delete and Issue events remain audit evidence.

capabilities.intent: Manage Organization-scoped IssueType definitions and the optional Issue-to-IssueType relation without granting Repository permission or changing Issue workflow.

implementation.scope: Issue-owned Organization-scoped type definitions, enabled/tombstone lifecycle, optional same-Organization Issue assignment, exact replay and immutable type/Issue history.
implementation.note: FPT IssueType is Organization-scoped while remaining Issue-owned. Disabled types keep existing assignments readable but cannot be newly assigned; deletion is an immutable tombstone blocked while referenced. Type assignment uses Repository triage authority, never grants permission and never changes Issue state/workflow. Activation is atomic at this revision: schema, semantic overlay, contracts, API and tests coexist; no second adoption ledger or partial gate is used.

capabilities.intent: Read authorized issue-owned Repository metrics without transferring source or authorization authority to Insights.

implementation.scope: Repository-scoped issue metrics through an owner public query.
implementation.note: Owner query performs current Repository qualification/access checks; composition does not acquire business truth.

locators.note: Issue number is scoped to Repository and is not a global stable identifier.
